main.description: A patron's posted quest — a public ADVERT for work: the task, the reward, and the canonical skills it needs. An anchor that offers, deliveries, settlements, and ratings point at. The advert is not the deal: the BINDING party/reward/terms are whatever an org.buildguild.offer + org.buildguild.acceptance lock. Written to the patron's repo. Monetary amounts settle OFF-protocol, peer-to-peer; see org.buildguild.settlement.

reward.description: Human-readable reward (e.g. 'revenue share', '$500', 'kudos'). Monetary value settles off-protocol, peer-to-peer.

delegates.description: Optional DIDs authorized to act patron-side (file offers/acceptances/amendments) for this quest. For a guild-patron, charter roles/capabilities may grant this instead.
